tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab tu gnas pa'i phyag len mdor bsdus bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /blo dman rnams la phan bya'i phyir/ /rab gnas cho ga mdor bsdus bshad/ /rten gang yang rung ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa byed par 'dod pas/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ rang yi dam gyi lha gang rung du bskyed nas/ bzlas pa cung zad byas pa'i mthar mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ grub na bum pa gnyis bshams pa'i gcig tu yi dam gyi lha bskyed nas ∶ bzlas pa byas (《 zha 》 de'i sngags bzlas ) pas thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab nas bum pa gang bar bsam/ mchod bstod byas nas lha gshegs su gsol/ gcig la lha mi bskyed par de nyid la dmigs pa gtad de | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rten de la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug yungs dkar gyis brab cing sum bha ni'i sngags kyi mthar/ sarba bi gh+nān ∶ u tsa ta (《 zha 》 uts+tsha ṭa ) ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bgegs bskrad/ de nas dngos su bkru ba'am mi rung na me long la shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la bum pa gnyis pa'i chus bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar | | lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i mthar gong gi sngags brjod cing bkru/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing phyis pas dri ma thams cad dag par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i khri | pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan nam/ khro bo rnams la ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rten ngo shes pa rnams so so'i sa bon dang*/ mi shes pa rnams/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ las so so'i sku ji ltar yin pa bzhin bskyed la/ gzhan mchod rten dang lha khang la sogs pa sku'i rten rnams ni/

oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ pu sti dang dril bu la sogs pa gsung gi rten rnams ni āḥlas 'od dpag med dang | rdo rje la sogs pa thugs kyi rten rnams ni hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'khor lo dang 'phrul 'khor la sogs pa rnams ni ji ltar bris pa bzhin du bskyed do/ /rta bab dang*/ rdo rings dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang rdzing bu la sogs pa rnams ni yi ge gsum las lha rdzas las grub pa'i ngo bo nyid du bskyed do/ /de nas lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon pos sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ mdun du ji ltar bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa/ /rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas mdun du byon par bsams la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ dam tshig pa la 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ /sems can kun gyi don slad du/ /bdag gis 'byor pa nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams | | me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la | | rjes su brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin brlab cing | | 'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ (《 zha 》+ oṃ ) badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ | badz+ra a be sha aḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa dang rten de dbyer med par gyur par bsam mo/ /srung 'khor la sogs pa rnams la ni 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes las grub pa'i 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs nas bstim mo/ /skyed mos tshal la sogs pa la 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dang bkra shis pa'i dngos po de dag ji ltar bskyed pa'i rnam pas bkug cing bstim mo/ /de nas mi 'bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ snga ma ltar yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum du rgyas gdab bo/ /yang rang dang rten gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de la me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su yang rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chus gtor zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas bum pa'i chus rten thams cad kyi lus kun yongs su gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan pa'am/ yang na so so'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ zhes brjod pas thams cad la rigs lngas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /srung 'khor la sogs pa la ni dbang gi chu dang 'dres pas nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam mo/ /rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa ni mi dgos so/ /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa gang grub pa bya/ sta gon logs su mi byed na skabs 'dir spyan dbye man chad bya/ sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i lugs su byed na/

skabs 'dir mkhyen par gsol bar bya ste/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ / rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye ba/ / kun gyi byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge mos/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis | | rab gnas nangs par bgyid par 'tshal/ /tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa/ /kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ sku gzugs bsrung zhing zhal dgab bo/ /sta gon no/ /nangs par tho rangs mchod gtor la sogs pa gsar du bshams nas | rten yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i bar sta gon ltar byas nas/ spyan dbye bar bya ba'i phyir/ gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rjes spyan dbye ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*/ /dad pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyi bas/ /nam mkha'i mthas klas gyur pa'i sems can gyis/ / kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa ji ltar grub pa byas nas/ sngags kyi mnga' dbul ba'i phyir rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas rten gyi thugs kar thim zhing*/ de las kyang 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin brlabs sngags kyi rnam par rten de la zhugs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nus pa dang mnyam par gyur par bsam zhing*/ me tog lag tu bzung nas rten gang yin pa'i sngags ci grub pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā/ he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro ngha/ e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/

zhes gang grub pa brjod nas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ ∶ hrīḥbhu khaṃ badz+rī bha ba dṛ ḍho (《 zha 》 trāṃ hrī bh+ruṃ aṃ khaṃ bha wa ḍhi ḍa ) tiṣ+ṭha bhu khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod la rten dai la me tog gtor bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang me tog gtor nas rten de khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo/ /de nas mchod pa'i mnga' dbul bar bya ba'i phyir/ rgya cher bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams lha rdzas las grub pa sa dang nam mkha' dang bar snang khyab par byin gyis brlabs la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas phul nas | 'dod yon rnam pa lnga'i rdzas gang grub pa dngos su bzung zhing*/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la dbang bsgyur yang*/ /'gro ba'i don slad 'dod yon rnam lnga yis | | mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rin po che sna bdun 'bul zhing*/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus la | | bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro bas mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sap+ta ma hā rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa'am/ so bdun la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhis legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis | | 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /oṃ bud+dha k+ṣe tra bi shud+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas bstod pa'i mnga' dbul ba'i phyir/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/

/sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gror gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa | | thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang | | chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa/ /ma rig thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgron ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas/ /zhi ba rin chen mchog gling skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyod la kun nas 'dud | | sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ / gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstod do/ /de nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba'i phyir/ tshogs pa thams cad kyi me tog gi phreng ba bzung nas/ lha de nyid kyi bzlas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis dkon mchog gi rten 'di la rab tu gnas pa bgyis pa'i mthus/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad 'khor ba ji srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs 'di ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du/ ye shes pa thams cad 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi skyabs gnas dam par mdzad cing*/ yon gyi bdag pos gtsor byas pa thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

/zhes pa dang | srung 'khor la sogs pa la ni/ bye brag tu 'chang ba po la bar du gcod pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing thams cad kyis me tog gi char phab la/ slob dpon gyis rten gyi spyi bor rdo rje gtugs nas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ mchod rten dang lha khang la sogs pa rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa nyid du yongs su gyur pa las byung ba' ི mchod rten la sogs pa nyid du gyur par blta'o// slar yang ji ltar grub pa'i mchod pa dang bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma ni dang po rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i rten de nyid kyis gtsor byas pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa la a kā ro la sogs pa'i sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ de nas chos skyong dang*/ phyogs skyong 'byung po dang*/ bgegs dang*/ gzhi bdag la sogs pa rnams la yang so so'i cho gas dbul lo/ /chos skyong la ni rten 'di ji srid gnas kyi bar du srung ma mdzod cig ces bka' bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul ba'i phyir/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis me tog bzung la/ rten 'brel snying po sngon du brjod pa'i mthar/ phun sum tshogs pa (《 zha 》+ mnga' ba ) la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod nas/ bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag po dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig 'jig rten thams cad bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gi char dbab pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o/ /de nas bla ma yon gyis mnyes par byas nas/ bla mas yon gyi bdag po la mchod par bsgo zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa la sogs pas cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskangs la/ smon lam rgya chen po gdab cing*/ gtor ma'i mgron la sogs pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas dga' ston la longs spyad cing slar yang shis pa brjod la kha na ma tho ba rnams rten de nyid la bzod par gsol zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod nas/

las kyi rjes bsdu la chos bzhin du gnas par bya'o | | rgya che ba la tshig nyung zhing*/ /don che ba la tshegs chung ba'i/ /chos tshul 'di ni 'phags pa la/ /saṃ gha mi tras bskul nas sbyar/ /dge ba de yis 'gro kun la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /chos kyi rgyal tshab chen po ru// rab tu gnas pa byed par shog /rab tu gnas pa'i phyag len mdor bsdus pa/ chos rje sa skya pas ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ yu gur gyi ban+de saṃ gha mi tras bskul nas (《 zha 》+ 'phags pas ) shing mo yos bu'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po la sbyar ba'o// yang skabs 'ga' zhig tu bla ma khro phu bas zhus nas chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyis ci rigs pa bsnan no// // ༄༅/ /gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs | bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes thugs/ /rdo rje khro bor rnam sprul pa/ /gshin rje gshed dpal la btud de/ /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas stan bde ba la ci bde bar 'dug nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rang skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dmar por mos pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ dmar po bsams pa las 'od 'phros pas lus thams cad gang bas rang gi sdig pa sbyangs

| phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbur brgyan pa spyan drangs nas/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ na maḥshrī ya mā ri maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos | oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo 'dzin pa'i lha mo snying ga nas spros pas mchod nas/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig / bgyis dang de bzhin bgyid stsal gang*/ /gang yang rjes su yi rang ba/ /de dag mgon gyi spyan sngar bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /'phags pa'i dge tshogs rjes yi rangs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos/ / tshogs kyi mchog bcas skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /rang gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos kun ston pa yi/ /sgra dbyangs mdzes pas bzhugs gyur cig /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dang bas bsten par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /bsod nams kun nas gang bsags pa/ / rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du/ /gyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba'i mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas srung 'khor gyi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar zhing nang dmar la gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas | snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad yongs su sbyangs pas/ gzhal yas khang pa rnams su gyur nas/ 'od slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ nag po'i rtsigs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba'i steng du mda' yab las rin po che'i shar bu 'phyangs pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor rta babs bzhi'i steng du/ pad+ma dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa'i steng du gdugs phub cing phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng du/ lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres nas/ mdzes par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur ba'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ nang gi lha snam/

shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i grwa rnams su bcud kyis gang zhing | kha rgyan dang bcas pa'i bum pa brgyad dang*/ dbus su rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba'i mu khyud dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar nyi ma dang*/ shar ma gtogs pa'i rwa dbus ma gsum dang*/ sgo bzhir pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i ∶ gdan (《 lu 》 dkyil 'khor ) dang*/ shar gyi rwa dbus ma dang*/ phyi nang gi grwa brgyad du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan bsgom mo/ /de nas lha bskyed pa'i phyir gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes su bsgoms pa'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na | pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la/ zhes phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po dang*/ mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa (《 lu 》+ hūm̐ gis mtshan pa ) bsgom zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa āt+ma ko3 haṃ gi byin gyis brlab pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa sbyangs/ 'od zer slar 'dus nas gcig tu 'dres pa 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las bdag nyid dpal gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ spyan gsum pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sku thung zhing sbom la gzi brjid che ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/

klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing | stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma thal chen gyi rgya spangs shing*/ m-i mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gzhan sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ cha lugs yab dang 'dra ba dang*/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur bsgom pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas yum gyi mkha' pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa as mtshan pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes su chags pa'i 'od kyis/ sems can thams cad bkug zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig ler gyur pa las byung ba'i/ gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs su gyur pa sbyor mtshams nas spros pas/ snod dag pa'i gzhal yas khang rnams su bkod nas/ slar yang snyoms par zhugs pas/ rjes su chags pa'i mes yab yum 'od du zhu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i yi ge 'bru lngar gyur cing*/ de dag kyang skar mda' bzhin du phan tshun 'dres pas/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas thig le de las thig le bzhi mtshams bzhir 'phros pa las/ lha mo bzhir gyur nas glus bskul ba ni/ shar lho nas tsa rtsi kas | thugs rje'i khro bo'i rje btsun yid bzhengs la/ /sa gsum mtha' dag rmongs pa sol mdzod cig /ces pa dang*/ lho nub nas rdo rje phag mos/ jau bo sems ni g.yengs slad bdud bzhi las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /ces pa dang*/ nub byang nas dbyangs can mas/ 'jig rten mgron gnyer stong nyid ci ste bzhugs/ /rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams kyis bzhengs shig /ces pa dang*/ byang shar nas dkar mos/ byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas/ khyod ni stong nyid sems shing ci ste bzhugs/

/ zhes glus bskul nas/ lha mo rnams skar mda'i tshul gyis/ dbus kyi thig le la thim pa dang*/ thig le rim pa gnyis su gyur nas/ 'og gi thig le mam̐ las ma he dmar po dregs pa dang bcas shing rus pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ rwa dang rmig pa sngon po 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i mig gsum dang ldan zhing*/ kha nas lce glog ltar 'gyu bar gyur pa'i steng gi thig le hūm̐ las rdo rje dbyug pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las/ 'od zer phar 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod | sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim pas/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ gzhan mtshan nyid thams cad gong du bstan pa ltar bsgoms nas/ snga ma ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ snyoms par zhugs te bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba'i ngo bor bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /yang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu'i ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsams la/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod de rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /slar yang snyoms par zhugs shing thugs ka nas/ 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ gsang ba'i gnas nas babs pas/ yum gyi bha gar thig le bcu bdun du gyur pa las/ lha bcu gsum dang thod pa bzhi ste bcu bdun cig car bskyed nas rim gyis spro ba dang dgod par bya'o/ /de'ang dbus su ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las/ gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa/ hrīḥṣ+t+rī'i sngags kyis sbyor mtshams nas phyung nas spros pas/ sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas phyi'i gtso bo'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ shar du k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa las/

gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ dzi na dzika gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas shar gyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i shar gyi rwa dbus ma la dgod/ lhor ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las phra ma gshin rje gshed ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ oṃ rat+na dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi ser sna sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas lho phyogs kyi rwa dbus ma la dgod/ nub tu me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ oṃ ā ro lika gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nub phyogs kyi rwa dbus ma la dgod | byang du da las ral gri das mtshan pa las/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ oṃ pradz+nyā dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi phrag dog sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas byang gi rwa dbus ma la dgod/ de'i phyir rol du shar du ya las tho ba yas mtshan pa las/ tho ba gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ oṃ mut+ka ra ngh+rika gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi phung po'i bdud sbyangs/ dad pa'i stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgor dgod/ lhor tsa las dbyug pa tsas mtshan pa las | dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po phyag g.yas na dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i bdud sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas lho sgor dgod/ nub tu ni las pad+ma nis mtshan pa las/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ oṃ pad+ma dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi 'chi bdag gi bdud sbyangs/ dran pa'i stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nub sgor dgod/

byang du rwa las ral gri ras mtshan pa las/ ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ oṃ khaḍ+ga dhṛka gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi lha'i bu'i bdud sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la bkod/ slar 'dus nas byang sgor dgod do/ /nang gi shar lhor dzā las 'khor lo dzās mtshan pa las/ tsa rtsi ka dkar zhing skems pa 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ mo ha ra tis spros/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi shar lhor dgod/ lho nub tu sa las rdo rje sas mtshan pa las/ phag mo sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra tis spros | sems can rnams kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi lho nub tu dgod/ nub byang du doḥlas pad+ma doḥs mtshan pa las/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ oṃ rā ga ra tis spros/ sems can rnams kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi nub byang du dgod/ byang shar du ru las ral gri rus mtshan pa las/ go rī ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ oṃ badz+ra ra tis spros/ sems can rnams kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs | btang snyoms la bkod/ slar 'dus nas nang gi byang shar du dgod do// lha yab rnams kyi rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bor dang 'dra ba/ rang 'od kyi rig ma dang ldan zhing yum rnams kyi rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo dang 'dra ba/ rang 'od kyi thabs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi phyag g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas phan tshun 'khyud pa'o/ /phyi'i grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni rwa las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis spros/ sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba la bkod/ slar 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i grwa bzhir dgod do/ / shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas lha rnams kyi mig la sogs par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan bsams pa'i steng du/

mig tu k+ṣiṃ las sa'i snying po ∶ gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu (《 lu 》 dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa ) / rna bar dz+rīṃ las phyag na rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang ∶ tho ba (《 lu 》 thod pa ) 'dzin pa/ snar kham̐ las nam mkha'i snying po ∶ phra ma gshin rje gshed lta bu/ (《 lu 》 ser po rin po che 'dzin pa ) lcer gam̐ las 'jig rten dbang phyug ∶ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu (《 lu 》 dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa ) / dpral bar skam̐ las sgrib pa rnam par sel ba ∶ phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu (《 lu 》 ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa ) / snying gar sam̐ las kun tu bzang po ∶ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu (《 lu 》 dkar po dbyug pa 'dzin pa ) bskyed pas skye mched byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ∶ gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu (《 lu 》 dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa ) / mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ∶ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu (《 lu 》 dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa ) / snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ∶ phyag na rdo rje lta bu (《 lu 》 rdo rje 'dzin pa ) / thams cad kyang rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang 'dra zhing*/ rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ de gsum gyi thugs kar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi lha spyan drangs la bstim nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mām̐/
sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rigs lnga yab yum gyis

| dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad | lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i char phab/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo'i rnam pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ yang dbang gi lha de dag la snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sgo ba bzhi spros pas spyan drangs nas/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim par bya zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas pa/ oṃ mut+ka ra dzaḥ oṃ daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma baṃ/ oṃ khaḍ+ga hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur nas | lha thams cad kyi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba'i thugs kar/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' so so'i sa bon gyi yi ge nas 'bru tsam pa bsgom mo/ /yig 'bru de rnams las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams su gyur pa/ sbyor mtshams nas spros pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/ gong gi mchod pa'i sngags rnams dang*/ kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ khau bos khyod mthong rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs | khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang*/ /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ / chags pas brgyan pa khro bo'i yid/ /gar mdzad khyod nyid ro langs lags/ / sku lus sbom thung dmar po ste/ /rnam par sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/

/hrīḥṣ+tī'i gsang sngags dag gis ni/ khyod ni sa gsum 'khrul pa sel/ /rje btsun snying rje'i khro bo lags/ /gar mdzad khyod ni 'jig rten gzigs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal | | ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs | | sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ / 'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ khyab bdag chags pa'i chos 'byung gnas | | dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal | | phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed pos las kun byed | | sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ / sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal | oṃ sarba ta thā ga stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ lha mo rnams rang rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo/ /de nas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi/ lha rnams kyis gsol bas sku yongs su gang zhing tshim par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid gtad de mnyam par gzhag go /rnal 'byor chen po ste bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'od gsal ba bsgom pa ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das dang*/ snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor la bsdu/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yum dang bcas pa thams cad yab la bsdu/

yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la | de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la bsdus te/ sems cung zad bzung ngo*/ /mthar nā da'ang yal bas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de goms pa las mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas mnyam gzhag las ldang ba'i phyir/ 'od gsal ba las rang nyid gshin rje gshed yum dang gnyis su med par bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud dang bcas pa snga ma ltar dmigs nas/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas/ de dag gi byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo'i snying po dang*/ nye snying ngo | | oṃ āḥbadz+ra be tā lī hūm̐/ yum gyi'o/ /oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka hūm̐ | oṃ āḥ.ā ro lika hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dhṛka hūm̐/ rigs bzhi'o/ /oṃ āḥmo ha ra tī hūm̐ | oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra tī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra tī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra tī hūm̐/ yum bzhi'o// oṃ ā mut+ka ra dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdaṇ+ḍa dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+ma dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkhaḍ+ga dh+rika hūm̐/ sgo ba rnams kyi sngags te ci nus bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ / de nas gtor ma gnyis mngon du byas pa/ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du/ āḥlas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha

lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta | nub byang du shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang shar du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du lta ba bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ des sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga shin tu bzhu nas/ rgya skyegs gyi khu ba ltar dmar zhing tsha bar gyur/ rlangs pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la phog pas de thur du lhung nas dkrugs te zhu bas 'o ma ltar dkar zhing bsil bar gyur pa las/ lag g.yon bstan nas/ oṃ zhes brjod pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs/ g.yas pa bstan nas āḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs par bya/ gnyis ka bstan nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas nus pa dang*/ gzi brjid 'bar bar gyur | bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan nas/ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ 'chi med rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya dang hūm̐ brjod pas dwangs shing thogs pa med par byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bstim mo/ /de nas mdun du rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gy-i 'khor lo dmigs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas | gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis grub pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byung chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs shing*/ oṃ rak+ta ya ma a ri sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ gnyis su med par bstim pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ rak+ta mu ku ṭā ya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/ rak+ta mu khā ya/ rak+ṭa shā ri rā ya/

rak+ta bhu dza ya/ rak+ta muṇ+ḍa ṇa mā la a bha ra ṇā ya/ rak+ta ra tha sa ma ru ḍhā ya | rak+ta pad+ma ā sa nā ya/ rak+ta a bha ra ṇa bhu ṣa ṇā ya/ i mat ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa | ma ma/ bi gh+nān/ ha ra ha ra/ tsa turmā rā na/ ni bā rā ya ni bā rā ya/ bh+ra ma ya bh+ra ma ya/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ts+tshe da ts+tshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas phul la/ slar yang phyi dang nang gis mchod nas/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /ces pa la sogs pas bstod la 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ /gtor ma gnyis pa'ang snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas | phyogs skyong ba bcu bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba duṣ+tān in+d+rā ya/ ā di na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ṣa ya ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug gi shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ steng du tshangs pa/ de'i g.yas su zla ba/ g.yon du nyi ma/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo/ de'i g.yas su lha ma yin thag zangs ris/ g.yon du khyab 'jug rnams 'khod par bsams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba rnams gshin rje gshed 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa la gtor ma 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ in+d+rā ya hrīḥya mā yaṣ+t+rīḥb ru ṇā ya wi/ ku bai rā ya kṛ/ ī sha nā ya ta/ ag+na ye a/ nai t+yā ya na/ wā ya be na/ tsan+d+rā ya hūm̐/ arkā ya hūm̐/ bra h+ma ṇā ya phaṭa/ ba sun+dha rā yai phaṭa/ bai ma tsi tra swā/ biṣ+ṇa we hā/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥha/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas phul la | slar yang mchod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/

/de nas nongs par spyad pa rnams bzod par gsol nas yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma rnams dor ro/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gshin rje gshed du mos pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lces/ lus thams cad yongs su gang ba'i snying gar gshin rje gshed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyis kha me'i sgor phul bas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing bza'o/ /zas kyi lhag ma/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta piṇ+ḍa a si bh+yaḥswā hās | lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ / spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes | gti mug gshin rje gshed ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ phra ma gshin rje gshed ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ tsa rtsi ka byams pa tshad med pa/ rdo rje phag mo snying rje tshad med pa/ dbyangs can ma dga' ba tshad med pa/ dkar mo btang snyoms tshad med pa/ tho ba gshin rje gshed phung po'i bdud las rgyal ba dad pa'i stobs/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed nyon mongs pa'i bdud las rgyal ba brtson 'grus kyi stobs/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed 'chi bdag gi bdud las rgyal ba dran pa'i stobs/ ral gri gshin rje gshed lha'i bu'i bdud las rgyal ba ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs/

bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ 'dod pa'i yon tan dag pa dga' ba bzhi dang*/ phrin las bzhi dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes lha'i dag pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos thams cad dag pa'i ngo bo'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran par byas nas/ bdag gi dkyil 'khor ci 'dra ba de lta bur/ snod dang bcud thams cad rnam dag dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du bltas la yid gzung ngo | | de nas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar bsdus nas | gshin rje gshed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gnas pa don byed pa po dang*/ mchod pa'i yul dang*/ phyi'i snod bcud thams cad don bya ba'i yul dang*/ mchod pa po dang*/ sgo gsum gyi kun tu spyod pa dang*/ 'dod yon la longs spyod pa thams cad sems can gyi don gyi las dang lha mchod par bsgom zhing snang ba sna tshogs par rang bzhin stong pa ngo bo zung 'jug tu shes pa la ni don du mi 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med do/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal lo/ /nangs par ldang ba'i tshe rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo bzhis glus bskul bas/ rang nyid gshin rje gshed zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du bltas la ldang ngo*/ khrus ni dbang gi skabs dang mtshungs pa la yi ge brgya pa brjod pa dang*/ dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol ba ni khyad par ro/ /de ltar dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa la nan tan du byed pa ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyi gnas skabs rang dang gzhan gyi don byas nas/ mthar thug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/

/'di yi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka dpal 'dzin/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṃ ka de wa/ re ben+d+ra pra bha/ bla ma glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'phags pa (《 lu 》+ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po/ bla ma byang chub dpal bzang po ) rnams so/ /de ltar brgyud pa mchog las legs 'ongs pa'i/ / gshin rje gshed dpal sgrub thabs sbyar ba las/ /byung ba'i dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /gshin rje gshed dpal nyid du 'gyur bar shog /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brang ba 'di ni rgyal bu mad+ga la zhes bya bas nye bar bskul nas/ dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas lcags mo lug gi lo de bzhin gshegs pas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i zla ba la rgya nag cong to'i mkhar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// // ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo'i lhun ni rnam pa sna tshogs rin chen gyis/ /rnam par brgyan pa nyi ma'i 'od kyis snang bar byas pa lta bu yi/ /sku dang rgyan dang kha dog mchog dang 'od zer 'bar bas nyer lham pa/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar la btud de yi sgrub pa bdag gis bshad/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pas 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dur khrod la sogs par stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song

| sems can thams cad kyi don dus sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i don du/ gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ lag pa g.yas pa stan la reg la/ oṃ badz+ra ā sa ni hūm̐/ zhes pas stan rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab/ rang skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dmar por dmigs pa'i dpral bar pad+ma dang zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dang nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa la hūm̐ bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdag nyid bsrung*/ snying gi nang du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bla ma bzhugs pa spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang*/ na maḥshrī ya ma a ri maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs phyag 'tshal/ snying ga nas mchod rdzas rnams 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rim pa bzhin mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī ∶ rak+ta (《 lu 》 kar ta ) ya ma a ri/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 lu 》+ ye ) swā hā | pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 lu 》+ ye ) swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /la sogs pa'i sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum gsum du bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad pa/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod/ kun nas sems snyoms pa'i tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga (《 lu 》+ ni bi ) shung+ngha:sarba dharmā:yo ga shung+ngho3 haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs par bsgoms pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ sum̐ las ri rab shar shel/ lho baiḍū r+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa bang rim bzhi dang*/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ phyogs bcur 'od zer 'phros pa las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar zhing nang dmar ba gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad yongs su sbyangs pa gzhal yas khang pa rnams su gyur te/ 'od slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar po | ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ nag po'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ mda' yab kyis bskor ba'i 'og tu/ rin po che'i shar bu las/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ sgo bzhi'i thad so bzhir rta babs bzhi'i steng du pad+ma dang chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa'i steng du gdugs phub cing | phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar

∶ po'i steng du (《 lu 》 po la ) / lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris nas mdzes par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa | 'og gi gzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can/ rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i lte ba dang*/ rwa dbus ma bzhir/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan bsam mo/ /gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dang mi mgos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ dpal gshin rje gshed du gyur/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed/ dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa | sku mdog dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ phyag g.yon na bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas pa 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po bzungs nas gdengs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa cung zad bye zhing*/ drag po bzhad pa'i zhal ljags 'gyur bag can | sku sbom zhing lto ba rgyas pa/ dbu skra dang*/ sma ra ser zhing 'bar ba/ bzhengs pa'i zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i mgo dang*/ g.yon brkyang pas tshang ra mnan pa/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu/ 'jog po dmar pos rna ba/ rigs ldan khro bos dpung pa/ dung skyong ser pos phyag gi mkhrig ma/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul pa/ stobs kyi rgyu ljang gus se ral kha/ nor rgyas dkar pos rked pa/ pad+ma chen po dkar pos zhabs kyi mkhrig ma rnams brgyan zhing*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis kyang spras pa/ mi'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/

stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma/ phyag g.yas pa gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon thod pa gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thal chen gyi rgya spangs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gzhan rnam pa dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das ji lta ba dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gnyis ka yang ye shes gyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ tsartsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa | lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ phag mo ser mos 'khyud pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu ral gris mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'dzin zhing*/ gau rī ljang gus 'khyud pa/ phyag mtshan dang cha lugs gzhan rnams ni gtso bo yab yum dang dang 'dra ba'o/ /me'i mtshams su mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ bden bral du gser gyi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/ rlung du byu ru'i bum pa si h+las gang ba/ dbang ldan du dngul gyi bum pa ga bur gyis gang ba rnams kyi khar me tog dang 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i shing lo dang | bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pas brgyan par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas lha rnams kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las (《 lu 》+ 'od ) 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs | snga ma bzhin mchod/ rang gi snying ga nas/ tho ba dang*/ be con dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri 'dzin pa'i khro bo rnams spros te/

oṃ shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ oṃ mut+ka ra rak+ta ya ma a ri/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs dgug oṃ daṇ+ḍa ya ma a ri pra be sha ya hūm̐ gis gzhug pad+ma ya ma a ri ban+dha baṃ gyis dbyer med par gyur/ khaḍ+ga ya ma a ra ba shaṃ ku ru heḥs mnyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ dmigs nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta/ badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do | | yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas/ rigs lnga yab yum la/ sems dpa' dang khro bo dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo du mas bskor ba spyan drangs | snga ma ltar mchod nas/ oṃ āḥbhi ṣiñtsan+tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis dang*/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pas/ yab rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' dang | yum rnams la rang rang gi yab rnams kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas yum rnams kyi bha ga a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa dang*/ yab rnams kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse mo gcig par bskyed nas/ lha rnams mchod pa'i 'du shes kyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas phyi nang gi lha rnams mnyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa/ badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /yang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/

sangs rgyas thams cad yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams su gyur pa/ sbyor mtshams nas spros nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par bsgom zhing*/ sngags snga ma rnams brjod do/ /slar yang de dag gis/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ / gshin rje gshed dgyes 'jigs pa po/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ / sku yi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed dgyes 'jigs pa po/ /sems kyi rdo rje ston mdzad pa/ /rin chen rdo rjer phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab ston pa/ /phyag na ral grir phyag 'tshal 'dud | | sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod nas/ lha mo de dag rang gi thugs kar bstim ste/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de mnyam par bzhag go / bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yum dang bcas pa/ gtso bo la bsdu/ de yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ de rim gyis nā da la bsdus te sems gzung ngo*/ /mthar nā da'ang yal nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de goms pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur te/ 'od gsal ba bsgom pa'i tshul lo/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas 'od gsal las skad cig gis zung 'jug gi sku/ gshin rje gshed du bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/

rtsa'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud dang bcas pa snga ma ltar gsal btab nas/ yab rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros nas | yab yum gyi steng 'og gi sgo gnyis nas 'khor ba'i 'od kyi snang bas/ rang gi sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ hauṃ k+ṣauṃ/ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ra ya/ gri h+na gri h+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o | | oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se na a dhi pa ta ye/ ma hā durdān+ta da ma kā ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya | bi trā pa ya bi trā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dwe ṣa ra tī nu dra nu dra/ tru ṭa tru ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ rje btsun ma'i'o/ /oṃ mo hān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༵༵oṃ pi shu nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ (《 lu 》+ badz+ra ) rā gān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ i n+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpa' bo bzhi'i 'o/ /oṃ mo ha ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ pi shu na ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ rā ga ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ i ra tī hūm̐ dzaḥ dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma bzhi'i ste | ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzlas pa ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas gtor ma gnyis bshams la/ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du/ āḥlas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang shar du mam̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma | dbus su mu las dri chu/ steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi kha bcad pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las dbyug to hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas

| rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ des sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga shin tu bzhu nas/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar zhing tsha bar gyur/ rlangs pa dbyug to la phog pas/ de thur du lhung nas/ dkrugs te zhu ba las 'o ma ltar dkar zhing bsil bar gyur pa las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun du rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dmigs la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis grub pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs shing*/ oṃ shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstim pa la/ gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ rak+ta mu ku ṭā ya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/ rak+ta mu khā ya/ rak+ta shā ri rā ya/ rak+ta bhu dzā ya/ rak+ta muṇ+ḍa mā la bha ra ṇā ya | rak+ta ra tha sa ma ruḍhā ya/ rak+ta pad+ma ā sa nā ya/ rak+tā bha ra ṇa bhu ṣa ṇā ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gri h+na gri h+na/ ma ma bhi gh+nān/ ha ra ha ra/ tsa turmā rā na/ ni bā ra ya ni bā ra ya/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ bh+ra ma ya bh+ra ma ya/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ts+tshe da ts+tshe da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ mo ha ya ma a ri ye/ i mat ba liṃ/ gri h+na gri h+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi shu na ya ma a ri ye/ i mat

∶ ba liṃ/ gri h+na gri h+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ rā ga (《 lu 》 shu na ya mā ri ye/ oṃ rak+ta ) ya ma a ri ye/ i mat ba liṃ gri h+na gri h+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa | swā hā/ oṃ i ya ma a ri ye/ i mat ba liṃ/ gri h+na gri h+na/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ marme marmā/ be ghā te hūm̐/ badz+ra tsa rtsi ka ha ra ha ra/ suk+kat mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ a mu kat dzaḥ oṃ gho ṇe su gho ṇe/ badz+ra ma ma ki bha ra bha ra/ sat bha ra sat bha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ a mu kat dzaḥ oṃ marme marmā/ k+ṣo bha ṇi/ badz+ra sa ra swa ti/ da ra da ra/ tha ra tha ra/ pa ra pa ra/ ka n+ya ka n+ya ∶ dhu na dhu na/ (《 lu 》 hūm̐/ na na ) hūm̐ a mu kaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ gam+bhi re/ badz+ra karti ke gha gha hūm̐/ rak+ta sho ni ta pri ye/ gau ri ye a mu kaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ gti mug rdo rje la sogs pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab bo/ / gtor ma gnyis pa'ang snga ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba duṣ+tān/ in+d+rā ya ā di na sa pa ri wā rā na ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug gi shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ steng du tshangs pa/ de'i g.yas su zla ba/ g.yon du nyi ma/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo/ de'i g.yas su lha ma yin thag zangs ris/ g.yon du khyab 'jug rnams 'khod par bsams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba rnams gshin rje gshed du gyur pa la gtor ma dbul bar bsam zhing | oṃ in+d+rā ya na maḥhrīḥ ya mā ya na maḥṣ+t+rā+eḥ ba ru ṇā ya na maḥwi/ ku be rā ya na maḥkṛ/

ī sha nā ya nā maḥta/ ag+na ye na maḥ.a/ nai t+yā ya na maḥn/ wā ya be na maḥn/ tsan+d+rā ya na maḥhūm̐/ arkā ya na maḥhūm̐/ bra h+ma ṇā ya na maḥphaṭa/ ba sun+dhā rā yai na maḥphaṭa/ bai ma tsi trā ya na maḥswā/ sarba bhū te bh+yo na maḥhā/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi | hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ nongs par spyad pa bzod par gsol nas/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod nas mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la | rang gshin rje gshed du mos pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lces lus thams cad yongs su gang ba'i snying gar gshin rje gshed lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis kyis dgang blugs kyi kha me'i sgor phul bas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing bza'a'o/ /zas kyi lhag ma/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ta piṇ+ḍa a si bh+yaḥswā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes | gti mug gshin rje gshed me long lta bu'i ye shes/ phra ma gshin rje gshed mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ tsartsi ka byams pa tshad med pa/ rdo rje phag mo snying rje tshad med pa/ dbyangs can ma dga' ba tshad med pa/ dkar mo btang snyoms tshad med pa/ thod pa dang bcas pa'i bum pa bzhi ni 'dod pa'i yon tan dag pa dga' ba bzhi dang*/

phrin las bzhi dang | bde ba chen po'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes lha'i dag pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran par byas nas | snod bcud thams cad kyang de'i ngo bor blta'o/ /de nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor yum dang bcas pa snying gar bsdus nas/ rang nyid gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi nga rgyal gyis gnas la/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha'i sku/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyis bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du bsams te/ kun tu spyod pa thams cad lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du dmigs la kun tu spyad do/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang 'dra ba'o | | ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba dang mtshungs so/ khrus ni dbang gi skabs dang 'dra zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya'o/ /las kyi tshogs sgrub pa'i tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ rnal 'byor de dag la rgyun mi 'chad par nan tan du byas na/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyis gnas skabs kyi don nye bar bsgrubs nas/ sa dang lam thams cad bgrod de/ mthar thug bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /'di yi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka bī ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ gam+bhi ra ma ti | niṣ+ka laṅka de wa/ dpyal lo tsā ba/ slob dpon rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje/ 'phags pa rnams so/ /lung gi rjes 'brangs grub pa'i skyes bus rnam par sbyar ba'i gzhung gi don/ /man ngag dam pas rab tu brgyan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di 'phags pas sbyar/ /dge ba gang zhig nye bar bskrun pas bdag dang skye rgu thams cad kyis/

/srid zhi mthar byed gshin rje gshed dpal go 'phang dam pa thob par shog /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i gsal byed 'di ni/ dge slong sngags 'chang 'phags pas chu mo bya'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gcig gi snga dro'i cha la shing kun gyi mkhar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// // ༄༅/ /gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med rnam rol tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'jigs pa med par rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir gshin rje yi/ /gshed du gyur la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ 'di sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ stan bde ba la bsdad la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ gnas skabs su bdud dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i don du gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi snying gi nang du pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po las 'od 'phros pas/ thog mar rang gi lus gang bas sdig pa thams cad sbyangs/ de nas sna'i sgo nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar gshin rje gshed dmar po/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pas dbur brgyan pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ shrī sa ma ta rak+ta ya mā ri pā da naṃ ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas/ gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal nas/ /oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ zhes brjod pas/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /la sogs pas yan lag bdun pa lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol nas/ tshad med pa rnam pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa bhā āt+ma ko3 haṃ | zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms la/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shin tu rgya che ba'i steng du/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ dmar po las rdo rje sngon po dang mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar por gyur/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgya che ba'i steng du/ ma he dmar po rwa dang rmig pa sngon po shin tu khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i steng na gshin rje khas bub tu bsgyel pa'i steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhabs g.yas pa bskum pas ma he'i rwa'i bar dang*/ g.yon pa brkyang bas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ mi mgo dang bcas pa'i dbyug pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/

dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing*/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dang*/ dpa' ba dang*/ mi sdug pa dang*/ dgod pa dang*/ drag shul dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ snying rje dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ zhi ∶ ba'i (《 lu 》 ba ste ) gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pa khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom mo/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 ham̐/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gis bsgoms pa dang*/ rjes su mthun pa gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drang*/ de rnams la snga ma bzhin du mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing | sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi | khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dgadabang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

zhes brjod pas/ dbang gi lha de rnams ye shes pa'i tshul gyis rang la gnyis su med par bstim pa dang*/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba dang*/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmar po nas 'bras tsam ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' dmigs nas | yum gyi bha ga pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje rtse mo lnga par bskyed nas/ snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig les yab yum gnyis ka'i sku yongs su gang nas rjes su chags pa las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i bde bas gnyis ka mnyes par byas/ de'i stobs kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gnyis su med pa'i bde bas mnyes/ sems can thams cad kyang sdug bsngal zhi/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas thig le rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pa'i rtser/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa gnas pas bdag nyid la mchod par bsam zhing*/ gong du brjod pa'i sngags rnams dang*/ / gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang*/ /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol du gsol/ gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod | | reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mig yor bzhin du rol du gsol/ /ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing mchod nas/ slar yang de dag nyid kyis/ kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ khyod mthong ba na bdag 'jigs te/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spangs/ khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang*/ /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo

| | chags pas brgyan pa khro bo'i yid/ /gar mdzad khyod ni rol langs gzugs | | sku lus sbom thung dmar po ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sku sprul zhing*/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis 'khyud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ khyod kyi hrīḥṣ+t+rī'i gsang sngags kyis/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul pa sel/ /rje btsun snying rje yis ni khro | | gar mdzad 'jig rten khyod gzigs 'dud/ /ces pas bstod nas/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams rang gi snying gar bsdus la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas lha'i sku sems dpa' sum brtsegs de nyid la dmigs la yid mnyam par bzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o | | rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod na/ gzhan dang mtshungs par bsgoms dang 'gal ba ni med do/ /'di'i bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gis ni 'od gsal bsgom pa nyid la gtso bor mdzad do/ /de'i rim pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la phog cing*/ de rnams bsdus nas gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim/ rang yang thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yang nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs par gyur nas stong pa nyid 'od gsal ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas mnyam gzhag las ldang ba'i tshe/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdag nyid gshin rje gshed snod bcud thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo'i dkyil 'khor du skad cig gis blta bar bya'o/ /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rang gi lus kyi nang yongs su gang bas sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/

bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ phyir 'phros pas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas de dag gi ye shes dang*/ byin rlabs yig 'bru'i rnam pas spyan drangs pa rang gi snying gar thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o | | de dag ji srid nus kyi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ snying po la 'bum phrag bcu bzhi dang*/ nye ba'i snying po la 'bum phrag bdun no/ /mchog bsgrub pa la ni tshad med do/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ / spyod lam sna tshogs pa 'jug pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed yab yum dang | snang ba thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur bsgoms nas/ oṃ zhes bya ba dang*/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags su bsgoms nas/ āḥzhes bya ba dang*/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul par bsams la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod nas de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa sgyu ma ltar gsal bar snang la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du lhun gyis grub pa ngo bo zung 'jug tu gnas par shes pas/ lhas lha la mchod par bsam zhing*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la sdang zhen med par longs spyod do/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni 'od gsal la 'jug pa dang 'dra zhing*/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni 'od gsal las ldang ba dang 'dra la/ rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim gyi skabs kyi bde ba chen po bsgom pa'i tshul dang 'dra ba nyid do// //tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed par 'dod pas/ rten dang nang gi mchod pa dang | chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ gzhan yang 'dir mkho ba'i yo byad rnams sta gon byas nas/

rim pa gnyis bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs pa dang*/ yi ge bdun pa'i sngags kyis mchod pa rnams bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge gsum las byung ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun du dmigs pa'i rten yod dam/ med kyang rung*/ bdag bskyed ji ltar ba bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i bcom ldan 'das la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa sprul pa rnams kyis/ gong gi mchod rdzas thogs nas mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ta ya mā ri | zhes kun la sbyar la/ a r+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 lu 》+ ye ) swā hā zhal bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri (《 lu 》+ chab ) / badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo rnams phul la/ nang gi mchod pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtheb srin gyi thor mas phul la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med par gyur pas mchod par bsam zhing*/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon bir+wa pa | ḍam̐ bi he ru ka dpal 'dzin/ dza ya ri pa/ bī ra ḍi pa/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṅka de wa/ ra wan pra bha/ bla ma shes rab rin chen/ zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma dang | yi dam gyi lha rnams la phul nas/ rang gi lce dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg pas lus kyi lha mchod nas/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la'ang mchod par bya'o/ /de nas 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad dang*/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas mchod par bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /zhes pa la sogs pas mchod nas/ bdag dang mchod pa'i lha mo nyid kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/

kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstod nas/ mchod pa'i lha mo de dag tshogs kyi zhing gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo/ /de nas gtor ma sbyang ba'i dang po yi ge bdun pas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs ba'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung | ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rak+ta dang | de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dang*/ mi mgos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa bskyed nas/ de las 'od 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bzhu nas kha dog dmar zhing reg bya tsha bar gyur/ yang dbyug pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa dbyug pa dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du babs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dkar zhing*/ reg bya bsil ba dri dang*/ ro dang*/ nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas gtor ma'i mgron du/ dpal gshin rje gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥhaḥbho ma hā kro dha ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ pra sā de pū dzaṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa pra sā daṃ ma di ma naṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ tshogs kyi zhing la gnyis su med par bstim pa'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥ ṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na rak+ta ya mā ri i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa ma ma bigh+nān ha ra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ snga ma bzhin du mchod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje nag po chen po la dbul lo | | gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong bcu/ nyi zla dang*/ thag zangs ris dang*/ khyab 'jug dang bcas pa'i phyogs skyong bcu bzhi spyan drangs la/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor du bskor bar bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la phog pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam par gyur pa rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad mngon du byas pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ nang mchod kyis bran nas/ yo byad rnams bteg pa'am/ bteg par mos la mdun bskyed dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad la phul bar bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di | | zhes pa la sogs pa lan gsum du brjod do/ /de nas phud dbul ba dang | dam tshig drang ba gzhan dang 'dra la/ phud kyis nang mchod kyi skabs ltar mchod nas/ slar yang rang nyid gshin rje gshed du gsal bar dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me 'bar bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba'i snying gar gshin rje gshed/ bla ma rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam pas dbur brgyan pa'i mtha' ma sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong bcu bzhi la 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyi sbyor bas kha hom khung du phul bas/ 'phags pa mchod pa dang*/

sems can tshim par bsam zhing*/ zas la ma zhen par longs spyad do/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs te/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad mdun du dmigs pa la byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ utsiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin nas/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis ding 'dir gsol/ /zhes shis pa brjod nas | yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs la/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces smon lam btab nas/ rten yod na gshegs su mi gsol zhing*/ med na badz+ra muḥs gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ las kyi rjes bsdus nas/ rang gi gnas bsrungs la ci bde bar spyad do/ mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang gzhan dang 'dra ba nyid do/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang ma 'brel ba'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor yang gong du bstan pa'i tshul nyid kyis bya'o/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas na 'di ltar spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni ring por mi thogs par bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur zhing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub ni zhar las 'grub pa nyid do/ /dpal 'byor kun mchog bde dang grol ba ste/ /de yi rtsa ba shes rab kho na yin/ /'tshe ba'i mthar thug bdud dang gshin rje ste/ /de yi rtsa ba ma rig pa las byung*/ /de phyir zhi bas shes rab skyed byed cing*/ khro bar gyur pas nyes pa drungs 'byin pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal dang dpal mgon gshin rje gshed/ /zhi dang khro dang gnyis ka zung 'jug tu/ /thub pa nyid kyis rnam par 'phrul pa gang*/ /gdul bya 'phags pa'i skyes mchog las brgyud nas/

/brgyud pa mchog nas mchog la brgyud gyur te/ / kun gyi byin brlabs man ngag la 'bab cing*/ /de yang de 'drar mkhyen pa'i mkhyen bzang zhing*/ /de sogs de 'drar 'dun pa'i 'dun pa can/ /jim gyim gyis ni rgyal la rgyal sras bzhin/ /bdag la bskul nas bskul bzhin bdag gis sbyar/ /sbyar ba'i dge dang dge ba de las gzhan/ /gzhan dang bdag gis bdag gir byas pa gang*/ /gang yod de yis de dang de dag kun/ /kun mkhyen kun bzang kun nas thob gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jigs pa med par rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen glo bo lo tsā ba las thob pa dang*/ thos pa bzhin dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa zhes bya bas sa mo sbrul gyi lo dpyid zla ra ba la cong to'i pho brang gsar pa'i dag byed khrus khang gi gling du sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs | bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ de bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya | de'i don du dpal gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom | de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ dmar po las/ rdo rje sngon po dang*/ mi mgo ser po mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar por gyur/
